headline: Boulevard de la Cultura
author: Ana Bryce
content: In January 2016, the Archdiocese of Lima expelled over sixty people who had been selling books and CDs for twenty-five years near what used to be known as the Cultural Boulevard located on Quilca street. Today, this area has become merely parking space after being converted following its sale post-eviction proceedings initiated back in 2008 against book vendors seeking reconsideration which went unanswered.

headline: Cristina Fernández declara
content: The former Argentine president, Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, alongside her children Maximo and Florencio, were summoned before Judge Claudio Bonadio regarding allegations involving money laundering and bribery linked through their family business 'Los Sauces'. This case investigates purported irregular dealings between government contractors and close associates during Fernandez's presidency.
